concerns.text: Task T002 fetches datasets via `matminer.datasets.load_dataset` (matbench_expt_gap, matbench_mp_e_form, boltztrap_mp). The specification (FR-001) explicitly requires the raw OQMD Band Gap and Formation Energy datasets and the AFLOW Thermal Conductivity dataset. Using matbench‑derived wrappers constitutes a weakening of the data‑source requirement because the provenance is indirect and may not match the exact OQMD/AFLOW releases mandated by the spec.

Task T007 defines the sensitivity sweep nominal coverage range as 0.80 → 0.99 in 0.01 steps. The specification (SC‑004) only requires a sweep from a “high baseline” up to 0.99, implying the baseline should be near the upper end of the interval (e.g., ≥ 0.90). Starting at 0.80 narrows the analysis to lower coverage levels without documented justification, effectively retroactively narrowing the scope of the sensitivity analysis.
